subject: [hw] DONE V41: AP side of the encoder + DMA mirror (568 checks; host-only)
body:
V41 is done and host-tested (no phone, no publish). Restarted session continued from the existing files: re-ran everything, added the pa-only registration path vcodecd needs, and re-ran again.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V41 PASS 568/568

  (529/529 in each of ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2 and TSan -O1, 39/39 twice against V40s real vcu/n2vcu.c, layout oracle 63 lines vs the kernel header, armv7 AAPCS static asserts; 9 s, /tmp/n2hw-V41.)

Files (all mine, all new in this phase): ap/mtk_venc_ipi.h (GPL-2.0: venc/vcodec IPI ids+structs and struct venc_vsi, 32-bit layout with _Static_asserts), ap/n2ap_venc.h (MIT: session API + the three DMA extensions + rev 2 n2vc_dma_guest_forget), ap/n2ap_venc.c (MIT: venc_vcu_if + venc_common_if + enc_pm clock steps + encoder ISR as a host library), ap/n2vc_dma.c (MIT: guest DMA mirror of include/n2vc_hw.h), ap/MESSAGE_FLOW.md (annotated session with kernel line citations), ap/test_v41/**.

What works: open (fourcc -> IPI id, INIT/INIT_DONE, vsi mapping), query_cap on IPI_VENC_COMMON, set_param for every type vcu_enc_set_param sends (data_item/data mapping + vsi->config, HEVC/MPEG4 profile/level), stream start (ENC, PREPEND only in JOINED mode), encode (SEQ_HDR/FRAME/FRAME_FINAL; serves POWER_ON/OFF -> hw->power with refcounts, WAIT_ISR -> hw->wait_irq with the kernel ISR status/timeout rule, PUT_BUFFER -> vsi free ring; free-list result precedence then ENCODE_DONE), close (DEINIT + power refs), bounded waits everywhere with -ETIMEDOUT abort semantics, daemon error status -> -EINVAL.
Rev 2 addition: `n2vc_dma_guest_register(h, NULL, handle, pa, bytes, NULL)` records a pa-only entry (no guest address space needed, no guest pages burnt) and `n2vc_dma_guest_forget(h, handle)` releases it; n2ap_venc_encode() takes such handles (no sync, tagged-handle cookie). This answers hw-ips question about vcodecds client buffers; the pa itself still has to come from the kernel (their RWVC_DMA_INFO proposal).

Not done (also in dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md): no phone run and no iOS link yet (build_ios.sh is IPs); single-plane source frames only (NV12/NV21); no timestamp/ROI/QP-map fields set in the encode message; power model granularity VENC+VENC_C1 per Linux clock-on (k02/p03 to confirm); one session per IPI id (kernel has the same single-handler design); the frozen n2vc_dma_guest_map still cannot record pa (header proposal open with hw-lead, not blocking); guest address space is never reclaimed (no n2a32_mem_free in the frozen header); no AP-side bitstream validation.

A review of V41 is welcome (hw-r1/hw-r2). I stay on the board for findings and for IV/IP integration questions.
